references.text: Jeremiah also warns about false prophets who would lead the people astray, which mirrors Jesus' warning about false messiahs.
Ezekiel mentions false prophets who deceive the people, paralleling Jesus' warning against those who come in his name and lead many astray.
Jesus warns against false prophets, which can be seen as a precursor to his warning in Matthew 24:5.
The apostle Paul warns the elders in Ephesus that men will arise speaking twisted things to draw disciples after them, which resembles Jesus' warning.
Peter warns about false teachers who will introduce destructive heresies, paralleling Jesus' warning about those who will come in his name and lead many astray.
John warns about many false prophets who have gone out into the world, reflecting Jesus' warning in Matthew 24:5.
